## Description

The first Quick start heading now reads **Turn off direct internet access for AI agents**. Its paragraph tells admins to open each provider’s admin console, select their organization, and turn off direct internet access for its agents, followed by the existing Thermus connection and service-access guidance. The shared page and copied Markdown use this same text; the canonical guide and external HTML mockup match.

## Review

Expected **T0 Auto merge**; the committed-candidate checker is pending. Production architecture and callable contracts are unchanged. The impact declaration has all classification flags false and `modelUpdated: false`.

Merge status: **blocked while required checks are running**. Focused and browser checks passed; the full ordinary suite, type checks, portal build, container/build gates, metrics, habit-hooks, and manager sign-off remain pending. No human review requirement is asserted until the checker completes.
